players.product: IBM Quantum Nighthawk (120 qubits, 218 tunable couplers) superconducting QPUs

quarterly_data.signal: IBM (10-Q): announced with the U.S. Department of Commerce a letter of intent to build Anderon, a pure-play quantum wafer foundry, with a $1 billion cash contribution by IBM alongside CHIPS Act incentives; IBM disclosed plans to invest more than $10 billion in quantum over the next five years, spanning R&D, capital expenditures, manufacturing scaling, M&A and ecosystem expansion.
quarterly_data.figure: IBM $1 billion cash contribution to Anderon; >$10 billion quantum investment plan over five years
